key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr offered the best combined wear and corrosion performance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
engineering_relevance: Spray-process selection can improve the durability of WC-10Co-4Cr-coated 304 stainless steel components exposed to friction and corrosion.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation, HVOF and HVAF spraying.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction and volume wear rates.
Evaluate corrosion response and identify wear mechanisms.
evidence_signal: HVAF reduced volume wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for uncoated steel to (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m) and showed the lowest corrosion current density among coatings at 1.75±0.02 µA/cm².
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting direct transfer to service environments.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
